messages.author: 8cf0e9896e9beef2
messages.subject: Pandoc binary not found
parts:
Hello folks,

I've just tried to deploy a very basic app, which tries to convert markdown to HTML via `pandoc`, but it seems that the binary cannot be found: https://daroczig.shinyapps.io/preview-markdown
Souces: https://gist.github.com/daroczig/e56e0e8ad3e8a3eed31e

Any ideas if these images comes with pandoc, and if so where is the binary?

Thanks, 
Gergely

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Pandoc binary not found
parts:
So we do have pandoc installed, as its used by the rmarkdown package. However its binary many not be accessible.

Have you tried using the rmarkdown package?

-Andy
